Commentary: Sri Lanka Squad: Pathum Nissanka, Kamindu Mendis, Kusal Mendis(w/c), Pavan Rathnayake, Charith Asalanka, Janith Liyanage, Dunith Wellalage, Sachindu Colombage, Eshan Malinga, Asitha Fernando, Dilshan Madushanka, Dushmantha Chameera, Dasun Shanaka, Kamil Mishara, Maheesh Theekshana

England Squad: Tom Banton, Ben Duckett, Joe Root, Harry Brook(c), Jordan Cox(w), Will Jacks, Rehan Ahmed, Gus Atkinson, Jamie Overton, Jofra Archer, Josh Tongue, Liam Dawson, Henry Crocombe, Sonny Baker, Dan Lawrence
Squads:
Dunith Wellalage to Will Jacks, FOUR, slightly short and Jacks is able to make the most of it. Goes back in the crease, muscles the pull wide of long-on and the fielder has no chance
Dunith Wellalage to Will Jacks, SIX, now Wellalage overcompensates, floats it up way too full and gets hammered down the ground. Lovely batting from Jacks!

Dunith Wellalage to Will Jacks, FOUR, arm-ball, it's fired in full outside off, Jacks is caught in the crease while looking to drive and gets a thick edge past the keeper. Some luck going his way this time
Dunith Wellalage to Will Jacks, no run, driven to the left of the bowler who makes a diving stop

Sachindu Colombage to Jordan Cox, 2 runs, skipping off a length on off stump, Cox goes back and tucks it gently into the vacant space at midwicket. Fielder had to come in from the boundary and they're back for two

Sachindu Colombage to Jordan Cox, 3 runs, sharp turn off a length, takes a thick edge as Cox looks to cut but there's no slip at this stage. Runs away fine and Wellalage manages to just about flick it back inside the ropes
Sachindu Colombage to Will Jacks, wide, dragged down short, it's down the leg-side as well and Jacks has missed out on the pull
Sachindu Colombage to Will Jacks, no run, tossed up and drifting in on middle and leg, Jacks defends
Sachindu Colombage to Will Jacks, 1 run, good length outside off, Jacks cuts wide of short extra cover who dives across and may have got a hand to it
Sachindu Colombage to Jordan Cox, 1 run, floated up on off, Cox knocks it past the bowler who fails to cut it off with a diving effort
Sachindu Colombage to Will Jacks, THATS OUT!! Caught!!

Sachindu Colombage to Will Jacks, out Caught by Charith Asalanka!! Jacks slaps his bat on the pad in frustration before walking off. Probably wasn't all that short to go for the pull. It turns away off a length from off, takes a thick top-edge and balloons up for a simple catch at short extra cover. A promising little knock comes to an end. Will Jacks c Charith Asalanka b Sachindu Colombage 25(21) [4s-2 6s-1]
Jamie Overton, right handed bat, comes to the crease
Eshan Malinga [6.0-0-33-0] is back into the attack
Eshan Malinga to Jordan Cox, 1 run, full toss on off, punched back firmly and mid-off makes a diving stop to his right
Eshan Malinga to Jamie Overton, 1 run, zips through from back of a length, Overton opens the face and taps it to the right of backward point
Eshan Malinga to Jordan Cox, FOUR, tailing in on middle and leg, full toss, and it's dispatched through midwicket as Cox swipes it across the line
Eshan Malinga to Jordan Cox, no run, nails the yorker on off stump, Cox gets the bat down in time and squeezes it to backward point
Eshan Malinga to Jordan Cox, FOUR, the slower ball gets hammered! Width on offer, Cox slaps hard and beats deep point to his right. There was a desperate attempt by the fielder there but in vain
Eshan Malinga to Jordan Cox, 1 run, good yorker on middle, squeezed away through midwicket
Sachindu Colombage to Jordan Cox, 2 runs, drifting in on middle and leg, good length ball, Cox bunts it wide of long-on and they charge across for the second. A cheer goes up as the 300 is raised
Sachindu Colombage to Jordan Cox, 1 run, drifting in on leg, he hangs back and tucks it gently into the on-side
Sachindu Colombage to Jamie Overton, 1 run, drifting down leg, he nudges it gently behind square
Sachindu Colombage to Jordan Cox, FOUR, the reverse-sweep runs away fine! Tossed up outside off, Cox gets in position quickly and drags it past short third
Sachindu Colombage to Jordan Cox, no run, drifting in on leg, he looks to nudge it across the line and gets a soft leading edge down the pitch

Sachindu Colombage to Jordan Cox, 1 run, Cox runs into the big frame of Overton and is thrown off course while the big man doesn't even budge. They both were looking at the ball as it was worked into the on-side and had a collision. No damage done thankfully
Eshan Malinga to Jordan Cox, 1 run, to long-off
Eshan Malinga to Jamie Overton, 1 run, to short third man

Eshan Malinga to Jordan Cox, 1 run, low full toss on the pads, he flicks it behind square and brings up fifty. Was a difficult start to his innings against Colombage but has managed to overcome that hurdle on the way to the milestone

Eshan Malinga to Jamie Overton, 1 run, simple chance goes down at long-on! Liyanage the fielder, is it? Yes it seems so. Slower length ball outside off, Overton has a hack across the line, miscues it in the air and it goes flat to Liyanage who drops a sitter
Eshan Malinga to Jordan Cox, 2 runs, slower dipping full toss, he tries a reverse-scoop and miscues it in the air over short third. Just about clears the fielder there and they're back for two
Eshan Malinga to Jordan Cox, FOUR, straying down leg and it's put away by Cox, whipping it behind square
Asitha Fernando [7.0-0-37-1] is back into the attack
Asitha Fernando to Jamie Overton, 2 runs, yorker on middle and leg, it's squeezed away through midwicket, back for two
Asitha Fernando to Jamie Overton, 2 runs, targetting the blockhole
Asitha Fernando to Jamie Overton, FOUR, oh dear!
Asitha Fernando to Jamie Overton, no ball, 2 runs, gets the yorker right
Asitha Fernando to Jamie Overton, 2 runs, to mid-on
Asitha Fernando to Jamie Overton, 1 run, full toss tailing in on leg
